text:
juan: Quick sync — green sweep scheduled in ~2h for the v2.4.0 bump. Need: merges, changelog check, and flaky triage. pinging owners.

alex: On it. Merging #834 (perf fixes) in ~10m then will re-run smoke.

maya: Changelog draft pushed to #changelog PR, left a note about the storage encryption change — need @sara to sign off on the security blurb.

sara: I can review in 15. Will check encryption wording + release notes.

ci-bot: Smoke pipeline queued by @juan: build 1234 started. Running unit + integration + smoke. ETA ~8m. Current status: running.

devops-bot: FYI autoscaler alert — dedicated pool CPU trending high; fallback routing will enable burst nodes if avg latency >300ms over 5m. No action required yet.

alex: CI log snippet shows 3 flaky failures so far: tests/test_kv.py::test_kv_timeout, tests/test_cache.py::test_cache_invalidate (timing), tests/test_stream.py::test_stream_resume (socket race). All intermittent on x86 runners.

maya: If any of those are the only failures we should consider quarantining to unblock release. I can open quarantine PR for test_kv and test_stream.

juan: Agreed. Rule: non-deterministic flakes -> quarantine, deterministic regressions -> block. If smoke ends with >1 deterministic failure, we hold.

alex: Repro'd test_kv timeout locally — looks like a 200ms sleep threshold; pushing a small fix to reduce contention, will include a note in the changelog.

ci-bot: Update: build 1234 finished — overall GREEN except 2 flaky tests marked flaky by runner: tests/test_cache.py::test_cache_invalidate and tests/test_stream.py::test_stream_resume. Artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/builds/1234/logs.zip

maya: Thanks. I'll open quarantine PRs and add a changelog note referencing the quarantine with rationale.

juan: Alex — please ensure version bump commit includes the changelog link and Docker tag.

alex: Done. Bumped to 2.4.0 in setup.cfg and updated docker tag in deploy/manifest. PR #840 is ready.

sara: Reviewing #840 now. Quick check: add migration note for KV schema?

alex: Added a short migration note to the changelog in the PR.

juan: Perfect. Plan: merge #834, #840, and quarantine PRs once CI passes final smoke. Then cut the release branch and kick off the final build. If anything unexpected, we'll rollback the bump.

devops-bot: Reminder: if we cut the branch during autoscaler pressure window, expect up to +10% build time.

ci-bot: Final status: release smoke (build 1234) -> GREEN (with quarantined flakes). Tagging: ready_for_cut.

juan: Awesome — merging now. Thanks all. If you see regressions, reply here immediately. @here :rocket:
